rationale: No blocking failures. Fusion measurements confirm the design intent: 1 solid body, 8/8 healthy features, 3/3 fully constrained sketches, bbox 64 x 60 x 50 mm, volume equal to the analytic model, 14/14 parameters in sync, and all 6 interface holes at designed position/axis/diameter. Rule checks pass but are ASSUMPTION status because the rule transcriptions (CAD_Design_Rules.md, ISO 273 table, edge-distance guideline) are not yet human-verified, and the bending check rests on assumed load (A03) and handbook material data (A02). Bending SF 14.4 vs required 2.0 means the bracket is conservative; thickness could be reduced if mass matters, but no mass target was given, and 5 mm is kept for bolt-clamping stiffness. Screenshot reviewed: geometry matches the plan.
